fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Guinea.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener al menos 6 meses de validez desde la fecha de llegada a Guinea.
entry.quote: To enter Guinea, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You can apply online for an e-visa for private and business travel, uploading documents including a yellow fever vaccination certificate.
entry.es: Puedes solicitar en línea un e-visa para viajes privados y de negocios, subiendo documentos que incluyen el certificado de fiebre amarilla.
entry.quote: You can apply online for an e-visa for private and business travel. You must apply several days in advance and upload scanned documents, including a yellow fever vaccination certificate.

entry.en: You must show your e-visa registration receipt at the entry checkpoint, where border officials issue the visa.
entry.es: Debes presentar el recibo de registro del e-visa en el control de entrada, donde los oficiales emiten la visa.
entry.quote: When you arrive in Guinea, take your e-visa registration receipt to the entry checkpoint, where border officials will issue your visa.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país con riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To enter Guinea, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: There is no limit on cash brought into Guinea, but leaving you cannot take more than 100,000 Guinean francs or 5,000 US dollars or the euro equivalent.
entry.es: No hay límite para el efectivo que entra, pero al salir no se puede llevar más de 100.000 francos guineanos o 5.000 dólares o su equivalente en euros.
entry.quote: There is no limit on cash you can bring into Guinea. When you leave, you cannot take more than 100,000 Guinean francs, or 5,000 US dollars or the equivalent in euros.

safety.en: Terrorist attacks in Guinea cannot be ruled out and could be indiscriminate, including in places visited by foreigners.
safety.es: No se pueden descartar atentados terroristas en Guinea, incluso en lugares visitados por extranjeros.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks in Guinea cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Public gatherings and demonstrations can start with little or no warning and may turn violent.
safety.es: Las concentraciones y manifestaciones pueden surgir con poco o ningún aviso y volverse violentas.
safety.quote: Public gatherings and demonstrations can start with little or no warning and may turn violent.

safety.en: Criminals posing as police or military have robbed drivers and passengers at gunpoint, particularly at night.
safety.es: Delincuentes que se hacen pasar por policías o militares han asaltado a conductores y pasajeros a punta de pistola, sobre todo de noche.
safety.quote: Criminals posing as police or military, armed with military weapons, have robbed drivers and their passengers at gunpoint, particularly at night.

safety.en: There is a high level of street crime, including mugging, pickpocketing and bag-snatching, and break-ins are common.
safety.es: Hay mucha delincuencia callejera, incluidos asaltos, carteristas y robo de bolsos, y los robos a viviendas son comunes.
safety.quote: There is also a high level of street crime – mugging, pickpocketing and bag-snatching.

safety.en: The British Embassy in Conakry is aware of police extorting cash from foreigners and Guineans.
safety.es: La embajada británica en Conakry sabe que la policía extorsiona con dinero a extranjeros y guineanos.
safety.quote: The British Embassy in Conakry is aware of police extorting cash from foreigners and Guineans.

safety.en: Exchanging foreign currency on the street is illegal, and foreigners have been arrested and held in military custody for using unofficial money changers.
safety.es: Cambiar divisas en la calle es ilegal y extranjeros han sido arrestados y retenidos por militares por usar cambistas informales.
safety.quote: Foreign nationals have been arrested and held in military custody for using unofficial money changers even for small amounts, including at the airport.

health.en: Medical facilities are poor, equipment is basic and often not sterile, and serious treatment requires medical evacuation to Europe.
health.es: Los servicios médicos son deficientes, el equipo es básico y a menudo no estéril, y los casos graves requieren evacuación a Europa.
health.quote: Medical facilities are poor. Equipment is basic and often not sterile.

health.en: Health risks include yellow fever, Zika, malaria, dengue and chikungunya.
health.es: Los riesgos de salud incluyen fiebre amarilla, Zika, malaria, dengue y chikungunya.
health.quote:
See what health risks you’ll face in Guinea, including:

- yellow fever

- Zika virus

- malaria and dengue

- chikungunya

health.en: There are occasional outbreaks of Ebola in Guinea, the last one in 2021.
health.es: Hay brotes ocasionales de ébola en Guinea; el último fue en 2021.
health.quote: There are occasional outbreaks of Ebola in Guinea. The last one was in 2021.

health.en: There are some well-stocked pharmacies in Conakry but few outside the capital.
health.es: Hay algunas farmacias bien surtidas en Conakry, pero pocas fuera de la capital.
health.quote: There are some well-stocked pharmacies in Conakry but few outside the capital.

health.en: Tap water is unsafe for drinking, so drink only bottled, unopened water.
health.es: El agua del grifo no es segura para beber; bebe solo agua embotellada sin abrir.
health.quote: Tap water is unsafe for drinking.  Drink only bottled, unopened, water.

health.en: There are no ambulance or emergency rescue services in Guinea and trauma care is extremely limited.
health.es: En Guinea no hay ambulancias ni servicios de rescate de emergencia y la atención de traumatismos es muy limitada.
health.quote: There are no ambulance or emergency rescue services in Guinea and trauma care is extremely limited.

help.en: There are no emergency services in Guinea, so for urgent medical help contact a clinic in Conakry.
help.es: No hay servicios de emergencia en Guinea; para ayuda médica urgente hay que contactar una clínica en Conakry.
help.quote: There are no emergency services in Guinea. If you need urgent medical assistance, contact a clinic in Conakry:

help.en: Clinique Pasteur in Conakry can be reached on +224 621 35 01 01 or +224 664 26 98 53.
help.es: Clinique Pasteur en Conakry atiende en +224 621 35 01 01 o +224 664 26 98 53.

help.en: To report a crime in Conakry, call the local police Commissaire on +224 622 86 94 71.
help.es: Para denunciar un delito en Conakry, llama al comisario de policía local al +224 622 86 94 71.
help.quote: For assistance or to report a crime in Conakry, call the local police Commissaire on +224 622 86 94 71.

help.en: The British Embassy in Conakry offers limited emergency consular help, strictly by appointment.
help.es: La embajada británica en Conakry ofrece ayuda consular de emergencia limitada, solo con cita.
help.quote: The British Embassy in Conakry can only provide limited emergency consular assistance. Access to the Embassy is strictly by appointment only.

getting_in.en: Royal Air Maroc flies from many European cities to Conakry via Casablanca, and Air France flies from Paris.
getting_in.es: Royal Air Maroc vuela desde varias ciudades europeas a Conakry vía Casablanca, y Air France desde París.
getting_in.quote: Royal Air Maroc (RAM) flies from numerous European cities to Conakry (CKY) via Casablanca.

getting_in.en: There are no passenger trains still operational in Guinea.
getting_in.es: Ya no funciona ningún tren de pasajeros en Guinea.
getting_in.quote: there are no passenger trains still operational in Guinea.

getting_in.en: The Guinea-Senegal border crossing is possible but very uncomfortable and requires patience.
getting_in.es: Cruzar la frontera Guinea-Senegal es posible pero muy incómodo y requiere paciencia.
getting_in.quote: Crossing the Guinean border with Senegal is possible but very uncomfortable and requires patience.

getting_in.en: A ferry called Sea Coach Express runs from Freetown, Sierra Leone every Wednesday, Friday and Sunday.
getting_in.es: El ferri Sea Coach Express sale de Freetown, Sierra Leona, los miércoles, viernes y domingos.
getting_in.quote: There is a ferry called Sea Coach Express from Freetown, Sierra Leone every Wednesday, Friday, and Sunday.

getting_in.en: The authorities may close the Guinea-Sierra Leone border at short notice.
getting_in.es: Las autoridades pueden cerrar la frontera Guinea-Sierra Leona con poco aviso.
getting_in.quote: The authorities may close the Guinea-Sierra Leone border at short notice.

getting_around.en: Taxis in Conakry are very inexpensive, and traffic there can be very heavy.
getting_around.es: Los taxis en Conakry son muy baratos y el tráfico puede ser muy denso.
getting_around.quote: Traffic in Conakry can be very heavy.

getting_around.en: Bush taxis are used for city-to-city transport, and departure times are never set.
getting_around.es: Los taxis colectivos conectan ciudades y las horas de salida nunca son fijas.
getting_around.quote: Bush Taxis ("504", for the common Peugeot 504 model) are used for transport from city to city.

getting_around.en: Intercity travel in Guinea requires a great deal of patience and a loose schedule.
getting_around.es: Viajar entre ciudades en Guinea requiere mucha paciencia y un itinerario flexible.
getting_around.quote: Intercity travel in Guinea requires a great deal of patience and a loose schedule.

getting_around.en: Road travel can be hazardous, especially in the rainy season from May to October, when roads can be flooded and impassable.
getting_around.es: Viajar por carretera puede ser peligroso, sobre todo en la temporada de lluvias de mayo a octubre, cuando hay inundaciones.
getting_around.quote: Road travel can be hazardous, especially during the rainy season from May to October.

getting_around.en: Taxis and long-distance buses are generally poorly maintained and overcrowded, and moto-taxis and shared taxis are not advised.
getting_around.es: Los taxis y autobuses de larga distancia suelen estar mal mantenidos y saturados; no se aconsejan mototaxis ni taxis compartidos.
getting_around.quote: Taxis and long-distance buses are generally poorly maintained, overcrowded, and the drivers are often unqualified.

getting_around.en: Fuel is not always available at petrol stations, so carry an emergency supply on long journeys.
getting_around.es: No siempre hay combustible en las gasolineras; lleva una reserva en viajes largos.
getting_around.quote: Fuel is not always available at petrol stations. Carry an emergency supply on long journeys.

money.en: The currency is the Guinean franc (GNF), with banknotes of 500 to 20,000 and rampant inflation.
money.es: La moneda es el franco guineano (GNF), con billetes de 500 a 20.000 y una inflación desbocada.
money.quote: The currency of the country is the Guinean franc (French: franc guinéen), denoted by the symbol "FG" or "Fr" or "GFr" (ISO currency code: GNF).

money.en: Credit cards are not widely used and obtaining hard currency is very difficult.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito no se usan mucho y conseguir divisas es muy difícil.
money.quote: Credit cards are not widely used in Guinea and obtaining hard currency is very difficult.

money.en: A few ATMs in Conakry accept foreign cards but give only small amounts and are unreliable.
money.es: Pocos cajeros en Conakry aceptan tarjetas extranjeras, entregan poco dinero y son poco fiables.
money.quote: There are a few ATMs in Conakry that accept foreign cards, but they give only small amounts of currency. They are also unreliable.

money.en: All Ecobank ATMs in Guinea take MasterCard or Visa for cash withdrawal.
money.es: Todos los cajeros Ecobank en Guinea aceptan MasterCard o Visa para retirar efectivo.
money.quote: All Ecobank ATMs in Guinea take MasterCard or Visa card for cash withdrawal.

money.en: Haggling is expected when buying souvenirs, and a rule of thumb is to halve the opening price.
money.es: Se espera regatear al comprar recuerdos; una regla práctica es ofrecer la mitad del precio inicial.
money.quote: Always haggle, especially if outside a major hotel as prices there are higher. A good rule of thumb is to halve whatever the opening price is

etiquette.en: Greetings are an important part of daily life, and it is expected to greet and ask how people are before getting to the point.
etiquette.es: Los saludos son parte importante de la vida diaria y se espera saludar y preguntar cómo está la persona antes de ir al grano.
etiquette.quote: Before getting to the point in a conversation, e-mail, etc., it is common and expected to greet somehow and ask how they are doing.

etiquette.en: Greet, eat and exchange money only with your right hand, as the left hand is considered unclean.
etiquette.es: Saluda, come y entrega dinero solo con la mano derecha; la izquierda se considera impura.
etiquette.quote: Greet, eat and exchange money only with your right hand; the left hand is used for bathroom purposes and is considered unclean.

etiquette.en: For women it is not advisable to wear clothing showing anything from the stomach to the knees.
etiquette.es: Para las mujeres no se aconseja ropa que muestre desde el estómago hasta las rodillas.
etiquette.quote: For women it is not advisable to wear clothing showing anything from the stomach to the knees!

etiquette.en: Being invited to eat at a Guinean home is a sign of respect, and the invitation should be accepted where possible.
etiquette.es: Que te inviten a comer en un hogar guineano es muestra de respeto y conviene aceptar si es posible.
etiquette.quote: Guineans will often invite you to eat at their home.  This is a sign of respect and consideration for the visitor.  Accept the invitation where possible.

etiquette.en: Photography is highly restricted at military bases, checkpoints, the President's offices and strategic sites such as airports and bridges.
etiquette.es: La fotografía está muy restringida en bases militares, controles, oficinas presidenciales y sitios estratégicos como aeropuertos y puentes.
etiquette.quote: It’s illegal to photograph or film anything of strategic value such as airports and bridges.

etiquette.en: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal in Guinea.
etiquette.es: La actividad sexual entre personas del mismo sexo es ilegal en Guinea.
